editorial:
You follow a Minnesota detective who teams up with a tough, committed vigilante to track down a ruthless predator behind a string of abductions and murders. The story moves through dark streets, tense interrogations, and shocking discoveries, giving you a gritty crime thriller that keeps you guessing about who is really in control. The cast brings serious weight to the screen, and the cat-and-mouse chase feels personal and urgent from the very first scene.

The acting is the biggest draw here, with strong performances that sell the emotional stakes even when the plot gets a little messy. The pacing stays brisk for most of the runtime, though some twists feel rushed and a few scenes drag near the middle. If you enjoy dark crime stories with moral gray areas and flawed heroes, you will find plenty to like. Watch it streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the predator is finally captured after a brutal confrontation. A twist reveals he has a split personality, with one side appearing innocent and the other responsible for the crimes. The vigilante takes brutal revenge before the killer is locked away in a psychiatric facility. In the last moment, you see a hint that the dangerous side may still be lurking, leaving you uneasy about whether the threat is truly over.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves gritty crime thrillers with moral gray areas.
